purpose: Fix E161 representation collapse (output L2 normalisation + low effective rank) and test whether the cross-session ranking reversal can be corrected by the training objective itself, using VICReg variance-covariance regularisation and simulated cross-session positive pairs. The E143 open-set protocol is reused verbatim and the E65 control must still reproduce W = 0.6958.
changes_vs_E161: 去掉输出的 L2 归一化：256 维 pooled 向量经加宽到 256 维的投影头输出（不接 BN），避免坍缩到低维球面
加入 VICReg 式方差 hinge（目标 std≥1）+ 去协方差项，权重扫 {0.0, 0.1, 1.0}
每个 trial 用两组互斥强扰动模拟跨会话正样本（A=通道增益+电极漂移，B=频带幅值重加权+噪声），并施加显式 MSE 不变性约束，把会话风格从身份中剥离

encoder.output: no L2 normalisation, no BatchNorm on the embedding
encoder.normalisation: per-trial per-channel mean removal, then division by the per-trial global RMS (fixed, no batch statistics)

train.loss: SupCon over within-task identity labels (both perturbation families as views) + invariance_weight * MSE(viewA, viewB) + vicreg_weight * (variance hinge + covariance penalty)
train.valid_metric: mean per-task leave-half-out nearest-centroid identity accuracy on the 0.6<frac<=0.8 block (Train only)

view_A_electrode.drift_sine_weight: U(-0.8, 0.8) * amplitude, 0.5-3 cycles per trial, random phase

augment.note: the two families are disjoint by design: A perturbs channel gain and electrode offsets only, B perturbs band amplitudes and additive noise only

protocol.loso_known_block: 0.6 < frac <= 0.8, prototypes from fit_rows (frac <= 0.6) of the 19 enrolled identities
protocol.threshold: 5-block Train OOF score quantile at each acceptance rate; LOSO uses per-fold known-block quantile

e161_reference.note: first 7 PCs explained 99.99% of the task-standardised embedding variance

reporting.test_official: N/A: Test has no public labels; session is used only for the diagnostic AUC after scoring
reporting.effective_rank: number of principal components of the task-standardised fit-row embeddings needed for 95% cumulative variance
